name: Waggle Right
purpose: The pass off the Buck Sweep. Guards pull, fullback fakes, halfback runs the sweep — and the quarterback keeps it and comes out the back door with two receivers. In the Wing-T this is the play that scores.

LE.rule: Release across and settle at eight yards on the boot side. Find open grass.

LT.rule: Block down on the first defender inside you.

LG.rule: PULL RIGHT like the sweep. You are selling the run — take a linebacker with you.

C.rule: Block back toward the boot side. Nobody chases through the middle.

RG.rule: Hinge and protect. Nobody comes free — the quarterback is alone back there.

RT.rule: Hinge and protect the boot side. Nobody comes free outside you.

RE.rule: Engage their end for a count, then release to the flat at four yards. You are the easy throw.

WB.rule: Release outside and run a corner route — eight yards, then break for the flag.

QB.rule: Fake to the fullback, fake the sweep to the halfback, then hide the ball and get to the edge. Throw the flat first, the corner second, and run it if neither is there.

FB.rule: Trap path into the line and get hit. Your fake is what freezes their linebackers.

HB.rule: Run the full sweep path at full speed with your arms tucked. Sell it to the sideline.

coaching_points: Every fake has to be real. This play is only open because they have seen the Buck Sweep four times already.
No blitzing is allowed at this age, so the quarterback has time. Teach him to get to the edge and look up.
Two reads and then run. Never let him drift backwards hunting a third option.
